主要内容: On February 18, 2014, the Compensation Committee of SanDisk Corporation approved executive compensation changes, including bonuses for fiscal year 2013 for named executive officers. Sanjay Mehrotra, President and Chief Executive Officer, received a $3,063,750 bonus. Judy Bruner, Executive Vice President, Administration and Chief Financial Officer, received $1,275,000. Sumit Sadana, Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer, received $960,000. The Committee also approved base salaries effective February 18, 2014: Mehrotra received $1,000,000, Bruner $620,000, and Sadana $516,000. Target bonus percentages for 2014 were set at 150% for Mehrotra, 100% for Bruner, and 90% for Sadana. The changes were part of the company's executive compensation strategy for the year.
